This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]]''' lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="SWG">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]] is set during the same time period as [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Galaxies'']]</ref> and was a practitioner of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He wielded a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and at one point used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force_Crush|crush]] an enemy's body both inside and out.<ref name="CrushCard">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Crush}}</ref>
